# Jade River Resort

> A luxury boutique resort of 13 rooms on the banks of the Lidder River in Pahalgam, Jammu & Kashmir, India. Part of Defoy Hotels & Resorts.

Core brand line: "Life, Slowed by the River."

## Property facts

- Name: Jade River Resort
- Parent brand: Defoy Hotels & Resorts
- Location: Pahalgam, Jammu & Kashmir — 192125, India
- Coordinates: 33.882774, 75.271524
- Elevation: 2,130 metres
- Total rooms: 13
- Setting: On the banks of the Lidder River, with a stream in front and dense Kashmiri pine forest behind. Wooden architecture, warm amber lighting, stone pathways.
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 7780868926
- Email: info@xogul.com
- Booking: Direct only. No OTAs such as MakeMyTrip or Booking.com.

## Rooms

1. Premium Balcony Room — 9 rooms — from ₹6,000 per night. Private balcony, mountain and resort views, luxury bedding, Wi-Fi, room service. Most popular.
2. Executive Suite — 2 suites — from ₹8,000 per night. Large living space, premium interiors, king bed, luxury bathroom. Best for couples and special occasions.
3. Executive Duplex Family Room — 2 rooms — from ₹13,000 per night. Two-level duplex for families; children have their own floor.

## Experiences

- Bonfire evenings beside the Lidder River.
- River walks at your own pace.
- Pahalgam sightseeing: Baisaran Valley (Mini Switzerland), Aru Valley, Betaab Valley, Chandanwari.
- Photography across the wooden architecture, stream, and forest.
- Family moments on spacious, safe lawns with duplex rooms.
- Quiet luxury: room service, premium bedding, attentive staff.

## Policies

- Cancellation: 15 or more days before arrival — full refund. 15 to 10 days — 50% retention. Within 10 days — 100% retention.
- Check-in: 2:00 PM. Check-out: 12:00 noon.
- Payment: minimum 50% advance to confirm.
- ID: valid government photo ID required. Foreign nationals need passport and visa. PAN cards are not accepted as address or ID proof.
- Policy queries: info@defoy.in. GST and invoices: accounts@defoy.in.

## Getting there

Srinagar Airport is approximately 96 km away, or 2.5 to 3 hours by road.
